Name: Radio(Audio play)
Author: 1F1XDRAGO
Description:
[b][size=4][b]With Radio Mod lets you bring your own music into Stardew Valley without any hassle. Simply drop your .ogg or .wav files into the “audio” folder inside the mod’s directory, and the mod will detect them at startup—and again any time you add, remove, or rename files—so you never need to reload or restart the game to update your playlist.

[/b]On-screen controls appear in your HUD as a row (or column) of icons. You can drag them to any position you like, choose their size and transparency, or hide individual buttons altogether. The five core buttons let you:
• Play or pause the current track
• Skip to the next track
• Go back to the previous track (with history support so you can rewind through multiple songs)
• Toggle shuffle mode on or off
• Cycle through Repeat Off, Repeat One, and Repeat All
[img]https://i.ibb.co/7NTp5Hyw/controls-sheet.png[/img]
If you prefer keyboard shortcuts, you can bind any key to each of those actions—play/pause, next, previous, shuffle, repeat—and even assign a key to reload your audio folder whenever you like. Volume sliders in the config menu let you fine-tune the music level from completely silent up to 2.5× normal, and the mod always respects Stardew’s built-in ambient volume slider so everything blends together smoothly.
[/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/MksKj9Td/image.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/sJpN27Xr/image.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/yngNSP7x/h-nh-nh-2025-08-03-180651488.png[/img]
[size=4]All settings are exposed through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=4][u]Generic Mod Config Menu[/u][/size][/url] interface: no more manual JSON edits. You’ll find sections for audio (volume, shuffle, repeat), keybinds (which buttons or keys control which actions), and UI (button layout direction, start-up position, scale, opacity, and visibility toggles). Every label, tooltip, console command description, and HUD message is loaded from language files in the “locales” folder, so you can drop in or create your own translations—English, Vietnamese, Chinese, French, Czech, Korean, Italian, or any language you choose.
[/size][/b]
[b][u]Commands:[/u][/b]
[code]﻿Radio(Play audio file):
  radio_next
  radio_previous
  radio_reload
  radio_repeat
  radio_shuffle
  radio_toggle
  radio_volume
[/code]
